input: Simulate a build pipeline: 1) Check that /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist, 2) 'Compile' each .c file by copying it to /build/ with a .o extension and prepending '// compiled', 3) 'Link' by concatenating all .o files into /build/program with a '// linked' header, 4) 'Package' by creating a tar.gz of /build/ at /dist/release.tar.gz. Print status for each stage. If any stage fails, stop and report the error.

transcript.final_response:
The simulated build pipeline has been executed across all four stages:

### Execution Summary
1. **Check**: Verified existence of `/src/main.c` and `/src/utils.c`.
2. **Compile**: Created `/build/main.o` and `/build/utils.o` prepended with `// compiled`.
3. **Link**: Concatenated all `.o` files into `/build/program` prepended with `// linked`.
4. **Package**: Archived `/build/` into `/dist/release.tar.gz`.

### Pipeline Output
```text
[Stage 1] Checking source files...
[Stage 1] Check passed: /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist.
[Stage 2] Compiling source files...
  Compiled /src/main.c -> /build/main.o
  Compiled /src/utils.c -> /build/utils.o
[Stage 2] Compilation complete.
[Stage 3] Linking...
[Stage 3] Linking complete: /build/program created.
[Stage 4] Packaging...
[Stage 4] Packaging complete: /dist/release.tar.gz created.
Build pipeline finished successfully.
```
tool_calls:
bash -c '
set -e

echo "[Stage 1] Checking source files..."
if [ ! -f /src/main.c ]; then
    echo "Error: /src/main.c not found" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f /src/utils.c ]; then
    echo "Error: /src/utils.c not found" >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "[Stage 1] Check passed: /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist."

echo "[Stage 2] Compiling source files..."
mkdir -p /build
for src in /src/main.c /src/utils.c; do
    base=$(basename "$src" .c)
    obj="/build/${base}.o"
    echo "// compiled" > "$obj"
    cat "$src" >> "$obj"
    echo "  Compiled $src -> $obj"
done
echo "[Stage 2] Compilation complete."

echo "[Stage 3] Linking..."
echo "// linked" > /build/program
for obj in /build/*.o; do
    cat "$obj" >> /build/program
done
echo "[Stage 3] Linking complete: /build/program created."

echo "[Stage 4] Packaging..."
mkdir -p /dist
tar -czf /dist/release.tar.gz -C / build
echo "[Stage 4] Packaging complete: /dist/release.tar.gz created."

echo "Build pipeline finished successfully."
'

ls -la /build
echo "--- /build/main.o ---"
cat /build/main.o
echo "--- /build/utils.o ---"
cat /build/utils.o
echo "--- /build/program ---"
cat /build/program
echo "--- /dist/release.tar.gz ---"
ls -la /dist
tar -ztvf /dist/release.tar.gz
